explication: OpenVAS Scanner is a vulnerability-scanning engine with a legacy C implementation and a newer Rust stack intended to consolidate scanner services. The principal workflow is a scan request entering openvasd, being scheduled and executed against targets using Vulnerability Tests (VTs), and exposing scan results through the API. The Rust runtime setup explicitly wires scan, VT, Notus, and container-image handlers; the tree and README document additional feed and protocol capabilities. Some internal C-to-Rust runtime wiring is not established by the sampled excerpts, so it is not inferred here.
